description: Reference-input resolution phase-1 differential (cardano 11.1.2 vs amaru 0925). Reachable-on-frozen-chain slice: reference-INPUT resolution (existing/nonexistent refs, ref==spend disjointness, duplicate/many). Reference-SCRIPT + inline-datum spends need pre-mined script UTxOs (substrate ask). Verdict + reason-class + input parity; fail-closed. All AGREE 2026-09-27.

cases.note: spend funding; read-only reference a distinct existing UTxO (not spent) -> both accept
same reference input listed twice -> dedup (set) -> both accept
three distinct reference inputs -> both accept
reference input 0000..#0 not in the UTxO set -> both reject (cardano BadInputsUTxO / amaru unknown ref input); same input named
funding UTxO used as BOTH spend input and reference input -> both reject (cardano BabbageNonDisjointRefInputs / amaru inputs in both reference and spent); same input named
